extracted.intended_audience: Project Gutenberg volunteers, eBook preparers, distributors, and readers (people converting, editing, or redistributing Project Gutenberg works)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and legal/ editorial requirements for preparing, editing, converting, and redistributing Project Gutenberg electronic works (including textual-editing conventions and the Full Project Gutenberg License obligations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Textual fidelity to printed source
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep the spelling, punctuation, and capitalization as close as possible to the printed text (First Folio) when creating the ASCII text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scanner's Notes: elongated S's changed to small s's and conjoined ae changed to 'ae'; the preparer has left spelling/punctuation/capitalization 'as close as possible' to the printed text but corrected some obvious mistakes. The edition used was a composite of more than 30 First Folio editions' best pages. Readers should be aware of historical printing conventions (e.g., u/v, vv for w) and resulting variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mark editorial additions with brackets
rubrics_metrics.description: Any text added by the editor/encoder must be indicated within square brackets [].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scanner's Notes: 'Everything within brackets [] is what I have added.' If a reader desires a purer original, they may delete bracketed material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial corrections and normalization (allowed but documented)
rubrics_metrics.description: Editors may correct spelling mistakes, typos, and expand abbreviations and may unify spellings according to a chosen template or spelling dictionary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scanner's Notes: corrected some spelling mistakes, typos and expanded abbreviations; a spelling dictionary devised from the Geneva Bible and Shakespeare's First Folio was used to unify spellings. Such interventions should be documented (e.g., in notes) so readers know what was changed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document source-collation and variation
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledge and document textual differences between source editions used and the fact that composite readings may have been used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scanner's Notes: textual differences exist between various First Folio copies due to printer corrections mid-run; the transcriber notes that their text is a composite of many First Folio pages and warns readers that variants may differ from other editions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retain or note canonical 'printing errors' thoughtfully
rubrics_metrics.description: Be explicit about whether canonical printing errors/orthographic oddities are preserved or modernized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Executive Director warns that some perceived 'errors' may be artefacts of the original printing process; the transcriber states 'we have NOT changed the canon errors' in at least some cases and asks readers to take that into account when reading the notes.
